CheckTitle: Ensure Unused Business Setups Are Disabled
Benchmark: CIS Oracle SaaS Cloud Applications Benchmark v1.0.0
SubSectionName: High Risk Business Transactions & User Actions
RequiredAccess: Fusion Applications Security Console / Audit Reports (IT Security Manager)
Fusion Cloud Applications Risk Management (Advanced Controls)
Description: Unused ledgers, suppliers, customers and similar setups should be inactivated, or their use monitored.
Risk: Unused setups can be used to post misleading journals or route payments.
AuditProcedure: Identify setups with no transactions in Reports and Analytics.
Automated alternative: deploy the matching Transaction/Access Controls in Fusion Cloud Applications Risk Management so changes start an investigation workflow. Examples: 30009, 32003, 33004.

Steps: Inactivate the setup, or monitor its use.
Review the affected transactions in Tools > Reports and Analytics, or monitor them continuously with Risk Management Transaction Controls.
